problem: Some of the new tests' configuration checks prove less than they look. (1) `assert own != sample` (the project's factory.toml text differs from the sample's) can never fail: set_keys always rewrites factory.toml after the copy, which drops the comments and reorders keys, so even the pre-fix code, which copied the sample's .factory over the project's, passes this line. (2) [state] is never checked, although the module docstring and the fix both say the project keeps its own [state]. A version of _install_product that also applies the sample's [state] (push = true) passes all five tests (checked in a scratch copy). (3) Only the tests and source keys of [paths] are checked. A version that applies only those two keys passes all five, leaving repo_config = [] and docs = [README.md, CLAUDE.md] instead of the sample's [.gitignore] and [README.md]. The code under test is correct today. The gap is that these sub-parts of PL6-7 have no test that would fail if they regressed.
proposed_resolution: In test_story_ready.py, replace the text comparison with assertions on the loaded configuration: config.get("state", "push") is False and delivery.mode is local. Assert that config.get("paths") equals the sample's [paths] table key for key (tests, harness, ci, repo_config, manifests, docs, source), read with tomllib from tests/e2e/sample-project/.factory/factory.toml.
